techniques.name: Giant word pulled back to reading size
techniques.description: One short word, centred, starts at about 2.5x so it overflows both frame edges, and scales down to 43% of frame width on expo.out (90% of travel in 0.43 s, settled by F14). A blurred blue light sits at the left edge. Hold 2-3 frames, then hard cut.
techniques.routeReason: A scale track on one text element; the light is a blurred radial div. No missing primitive.

techniques.name: Soft light slides off the name
techniques.description: On a hard cut the two-word name line appears with a large blurred blue light (#3599F5) covering its second half; the light slides right and off frame in 9 frames (F17-F26), uncovering the brand-coloured word. Line 52% of frame width, centred, first word navy, second brand blue.
techniques.routeReason: A blurred radial gradient translated over static type; no masking needed because the light is opaque enough to hide the word.

techniques.name: Word-by-word line on a saturated ground
techniques.description: Hard cut to a saturated blue ground (#0966F6). White words cut on one at a time (F39 first word, F41 a dash, F45 the second word), centred, glyph height 13.6% of frame height; the line drifts slightly. At F67 the whole line is replaced by one noun (12.2%), held 14 frames, then a hard cut back to white.
techniques.routeReason: Per-word visibility from a schedule on a flat ground.

typography.entry: word-by-word cut-on, 2-4 frames apart, then whole-line swap

techniques.name: Type steps down to the interface's size, then dissolves into it
techniques.description: Each premise line is smaller than the last: glyph height 16.1% (name), 13.6%, 12.2%, 9.7%, 6.7% of frame height. The last sentence (57% of width) is at the scale of the interface title that replaces it. Words of that sentence arrive pale blue and darken over 3-4 frames, about 3-4 frames apart (F106, F109, F113, F116). Then the sentence fades out from left to right as the interface fades in at the same place, F127-F142 (0.63 s).
techniques.routeReason: Font sizes from a list, a per-word opacity and colour track, and a gradient mask crossfade between the type layer and the interface capture. Interface shots must be a real capture of the new product (capture:app or a screen recording), never a generic mock-up.

typography.entry: per-word fade from pale blue to navy, 3-4 frames each

techniques.name: Hard punch-ins on the interface while typing
techniques.description: Cut from wide to about 1.8x on the prompt field as the first character is typed (F158), cut back to wide when the line overflows the close frame (F194), cut to a 7x macro of the send button (F232). In the later headline-size prompt the same idea moves sideways: one frame (F399) jumps the view to the field's right end at the same scale so the cursor and send button are in frame. Typing runs at roughly one character per frame. Close shots drift slowly; scale is never animated.
techniques.routeReason: Three crops of one high-resolution capture of the real interface with a typed-text overlay or a recorded typing pass; hard cuts between crops. Capture at 2x or more for the macro. Interface shots must be a real capture of the new product (capture:app or a screen recording), never a generic mock-up.

typography.entry: typewriter, about 1 character per frame, caret visible

techniques.name: Accelerating drift into a hard cut, continued after it
techniques.description: The last 0.3-0.5 s of a shot drifts (up, or left) with rising speed and hard-cuts at peak speed; the next shot's main element moves the same way and settles in 4-6 frames. Seen five times; the clearest are the table drifting left into 15.292 (circ.in, 0.40 s, motion.json s007), the benefit card panning left into 19.25, and the clicked field drifting up into a card that rises and settles (F418-F433).
techniques.routeReason: A y or x track with an ease-in on the outgoing shot and an ease-out on the incoming one, optional VelocityBlur keyed to speed.

evidence: motion.json s007 camera t5Sec 14.844 to t95Sec 15.242, cut 15.292

techniques.name: Shimmer placeholder grows into the answer
techniques.description: A purple-to-lilac vertical-band gradient grows from a dot at the start of the reply line to the answer's full size in 12 frames (F328-F340) while the chat scrolls up; its bands slide sideways; the answer's text dissolves in through it over 6 frames (F344-F350) as the gradient fades to the table's header colour.
techniques.routeReason: A rounded rect with a scrolling linear-gradient fill, a size track from the reply line's origin, then a crossfade to a capture of the real answer. Interface shots must be a real capture of the new product (capture:app or a screen recording), never a generic mock-up.

techniques.name: Near-silence under the proof, cut ahead of the return
techniques.description: After the answer resolves the music drops to near silence for about 0.7 s (RMS about 50 vs a quiet-section median of 1322), rises from 15.18 s, the picture cuts to a new ground at 15.292 and the music reaches full level at about 15.55 s (6 frames after the cut). The second half is about 3.5x the energy of the first.
techniques.routeReason: An edit decision on a licensed or original track: place a stop and a riser, cut 6 frames before the hit (cueFrame with a negative lead).

sound.note: Gap and re-entry times are measured from RMS; what plays is inferred. I cannot hear the film.

techniques.name: Question typed at headline size, camera following the caret
techniques.description: The prompt field fills the frame width at headline size on a pale ground (OCR box height 0.09-0.15 of frame against 0.037 in the wide interface shots); characters arrive about one per frame and the camera tracks right to keep the caret right of centre; the field runs off the left edge (OCR boxes at x=0). In the first prompt one jump reframe (F399) brings the field's end and send button into frame; a cursor clicks send (button turns grey at F415) and the shot drifts up into the cut. In the second the product name is typed in brand blue.
techniques.routeReason: A typed line in a field component built to the real interface, inside a camera that tracks the caret position; a cursor with a click. The field must match the real product. Interface shots must be a real capture of the new product (capture:app or a screen recording), never a generic mock-up.

techniques.name: Benefit rows ticked one after another
techniques.description: A white rounded card (about 60% of frame width) rises onto a pale-blue gradient and settles in 6 frames; three rows each have a title, a grey subline and an empty circle. Each circle fills black with a radial clock wipe in 3-4 frames and shows a white tick: row 1 F435-F438, row 2 F444-F447, row 3 F451-F454 (9 then 7 frames apart).
techniques.routeReason: Three conic-gradient fills on a schedule; the card is plain layout. No checklist block exists in the library.

sound.note: Row 1 is filled at F438 (18.25 s) on a tracked beat (18.251); row 2 at F444 (18.50) falls on the half-beat; row 3 starts at F451 (18.79), 50 ms after the beat at 18.739. Tempo confidence 0.55, so this is not a grid; a sound at each tick is inferred.

techniques.name: Working indicator, then the answer streams in
techniques.description: The sent question sits top right in a pale bubble with an avatar; a small blue dot pulses with a shimmering status word for 1.8-2.5 s; then the answer appears line by line at body size (about 2% glyph height) with a fading leading edge. The view slowly pushes and drifts up as text accumulates.
techniques.routeReason: A capture of the real assistant answering, sped up, or the real UI rebuilt with a streamed-text schedule. Interface shots must be a real capture of the new product (capture:app or a screen recording), never a generic mock-up.

techniques.name: Benefit sentence fades up word by word over a corner glow
techniques.description: The chat fades through white as a blue glow grows into the bottom-right corner (F612-F619); then a single centred sentence (57% width, 6.4% glyph height, navy) arrives word by word, each word fading from pale blue and rising a few pixels into the baseline over about 4 frames, about 5 frames apart (F620 first word, F625 second).
techniques.routeReason: Corner radial gradient plus per-word opacity and y tracks; the corner light is block liquid-light without its rim (a plain soft glow).

typography.entry: word fade-up from pale blue, about 4 frames, 5 frames apart

techniques.name: Wordmark revealed left to right, tagline beneath
techniques.description: Hard cut to the lower-case bold wordmark in cyan (#2FBAFA), about 40% of width with its tagline, revealed by a soft-edged left-to-right wipe over 10 frames (F657-F667); a small navy tagline appears beneath in two parts (first clause at F667, second about 0.5 s later). Corner glow and faint floating squares stay.
techniques.routeReason: A linear-gradient mask whose position is tracked across the wordmark; tagline clauses on a schedule. Use the new brand's own wordmark file.

typography.entry: soft-edge wipe left to right, 10 frames

techniques.name: Two text swaps on a held ground to close

No fade at the end.
techniques.routeReason: Two Sequences on one background; the last frame is the thumbnail.
